title: Risk-Aware Joint Inference and Resource Control for Physical AI in 6G Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.14696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wireless edge inference enables Physical-AI devices to execute edge-inferred actions using transmitted sensory inputs. Since the risk of incorrect actions vary across observations and tasks, the associated uplink transmission of sensory inputs requires different levels of wireless reliability. For instance, applying a fixed signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) requirement can overprovision low-risk tasks while underprovisioning high-risk ones. Therefore, we propose risk-aware control for edge inference (RACE), which maps predicted action-failure probability and task criticality to adaptive SINR targets and combines them with deadline-derived SINR requirements. A slow-timescale large language model (LLM) proposes task requirements for deterministic validation, while a fast hybrid actor selects inference configurations and transmit power levels, complemented by analytical receive beamforming and finite power restoration. translated_title: 6G网络中面向物理AI的风险感知联合推理与资源控制
translated_abstract: 无线边缘推理使物理AI设备能够利用传输的感知输入执行由边缘推断出的动作。由于错误动作的风险因观测和任务而异，相应的感知输入上行传输需要不同级别的无线可靠性。例如，采用固定的信干噪比（SINR）要求会导致对低风险任务过度配置，而对高风险任务配置不足。为此，我们提出了面向边缘推理的风险感知控制（RACE），该方法将预测的动作失败概率和任务关键性映射为自适应SINR目标，并将其与由截止时间推导出的SINR要求相结合。慢时间尺度的大语言模型（LLM）提出任务要求以进行确定性验证，而快速的混合执行器则选择推理配置和发射功率水平，并辅以解析接收波束成形和有限功率恢复。仿真……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RACE框架，将预测的动作失败概率与任务关键性映射为自适应SINR目标，并结合慢时间尺度LLM与快速混合执行器，实现6G网络中物理AI边缘推理的风险感知资源控制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RACE, a risk-aware framework that maps predicted action-failure probability and task criticality to adaptive SINR targets, combining a slow-timescale LLM with a fast hybrid actor for risk-aware joint inference and resource control for Physical AI in 6G networks.
